# @noppu-labs/opencode-toolkit-core

The shared core of the toolkit's OpenCode packages. For now it holds the skill loader and the table that names skills per package, and more shared code will join them.

You never install this package directly. Install a plugin package such as `@noppu-labs/opencode-review`, which depends on it.
